description: Irregular triangle read by rows, where row n is the lexicographically earliest sequence starting with T(n,1) = n, allowed integers are >= n, and each term T(n,k) is banned for the next T(n,k) terms in that row. If the sequence for row n is eventually periodic, the row terminates at the end of the first period; however, if it is not eventually periodic, the row is infinite.
